data: Is the value of the line with triangle markers greater than 10 at a distance of 100?

The line with triangle markers represents the correlation values for 'she > she' pronouns. At a distance of 100, the value of this line is approximately 2. This value is clearly less than 10. Therefore, the statement "the value of the line with triangle markers is greater than 10 at a distance of 100" is false.
